text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf let the Triple Crown slip 
through her fingers. If so, she needed a 
proof worthy of taking its place. Her 
sights were set vigilantly on the Shield: 
the Tenno Sho (Spring).

Symboli Rudolf was already brimming with 
high spirits for her next race. In stark 
contrast, Air Groove, waiting in the 
anteroom, was not looking well at all.

Air Groove pushed herself too hard trying 
to lighten Symboli Rudolf's load, while 
Symboli Rudolf remained determined to 
fully carry out her duties as President.

Caring so much for each other that they 
ended up passing like ships in the night. 
Without quite finding their sync, they 
were about to greet the new year.
